This explorer extends the wave-specific P-score summaries to every registered
geography and original age group. Use the first control to switch between
paired male/female results and total-population results. The two tables keep
independent searches, column filters, sorting, page sizes, and page positions.
Failed or unavailable components remain explicit and are never imputed.

```{=html}
<div id="supplementary-table-explorer" class="tablex-app" data-table-app data-root="assets/supplementary/table_explorer">
  <div class="tablex-view-switch" role="group" aria-label="Population table">
    <button type="button" data-view="sex" aria-pressed="true">Sex-stratified (M/F)</button>
    <button type="button" data-view="total" aria-pressed="false">Total population</button>
  </div>
  <div class="tablex-toolbar" aria-label="Supplementary table controls">
    <label class="tablex-search">Search all columns
      <input type="search" data-control="global-search" placeholder="Region, geography, age, wave value…" autocomplete="off">
    </label>
    <label>Rows per page
      <select data-control="page-size">
        <option value="10">10</option>
        <option value="25" selected>25</option>
        <option value="50">50</option>
        <option value="100">100</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-default" data-action="clear">Clear filters</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-action="download">Download filtered CSV</button>
  </div>

  <div class="tablex-meta" data-role="metadata" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <div class="tablex-table-shell" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable supplementary P-score table" tabindex="0">
    <table class="tablex-table">
      <caption class="sr-only">Wave-specific P-scores by population view, region, geography, and original age group</caption>
      <thead data-role="table-head"></thead>
      <tbody data-role="table-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="tablex-footer">
    <span class="tablex-status" data-role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading frozen table summaries…</span>
    <nav class="tablex-pagination" data-role="pagination" aria-label="Table pages"></nav>
  </div>
</div>

<noscript>This explorer requires JavaScript. The complete expanded table remains available as a CSV from the <a href="supplementary.html">supplementary landing page</a>.</noscript>
```

Vaccination coverage and group membership use the same fixed mid-2021 inputs
as the manuscript analysis. These fields are shown as `NA` for Canada, England
and Wales, and Ireland because those analyses do not use the comparable Europe
or United States vaccination snapshots. Total-population analyses include the
registered total models for locations such as Germany, Prince Edward Island,
England and Wales, and Ireland.

The reader-facing table is summary-only. It contains no fitted model objects,
posterior draw matrices, or internal manuscript-equivalence fields. The latter
remain part of the local frozen-bundle validation performed before publication.
